result:
All three deliverables are in place and verified:

- **`script.R`** — self-contained; Okabe-Ito palette and `theme_amce` declared up top, `set.seed(1234)` before any stochastic step, runs `projoint()` with `.structure = "profile_level"`, `.estimand = "amce"`, respondent-level clustering (auto-cluster on `id`), reports the measurement-error-corrected AMCE (one-line justification in comments for using `amce_corrected` over `amce_uncorrected`).
- **`figures/amce-dotwhisker.png`** — 3200×2560px at 320 dpi, dot-and-whisker plot grouped by attribute (facets), levels ordered as presented to respondents, reference levels at zero with no interval, no in-plot title.
- **`report.md`** — 190-word results paragraph covering the largest effects (crime, commute, housing cost, place type, school quality) in percentage points with direction, a sentence on uncertainty, followed by the figure and its caption placed directly underneath.

Ran end-to-end (`Rscript script.R`) with no errors — only an expected informational warning from `projoint` about its CR2→stata SE fallback.
